probe.tests: 100 checks with one dependency; 100 checks with eight; if their total wall time is below one second, 25 checks with 32
probe.safety: Creates only public synthetic SQLite in its own TemporaryDirectory; closes all connections and removes only that owned temporary directory; emits metadata only

cost_per_prepared_check.SELECT_statements: 6 + N, where N is the assistant durable dependency count
cost_per_prepared_check.source: _turn_authority opens one DB; check_prepared opens another; both _validate_sources loops issue one SELECT per source ID
cost_per_prepared_check.profile: Original ProfileAccess RLock spans the second DB read for profile scope; anonymous scope has no profile lock
cost_per_prepared_check.jobs_condition: Not held while admission_guard performs SQL
cost_per_prepared_check.writes: No DML in this path; pure read COMMIT does not establish per-packet fsync/fdatasync. Probe verifies DB bytes unchanged.

production_path.backpressure: Each queue wait of up to 50ms loops back through the full guard again
production_path.steady_state_implication: At 50 audio packets per second, at least 100 SQLite connections and 50*(6+N) SELECTs per second, plus non-audio events and backpressure retries
production_path.consumer: This SQL is not inside the audio device callback, but slow production can starve it

important_timing_caveat.first_chunk_emitted_ms: Recorded only after the whole first sentence sink returns, not after its first audio packet
important_timing_caveat.prepare_total_ms: Includes streaming queue backpressure while the player consumes previous audio
important_timing_caveat.effect: A longer sentence can legitimately wait approximately sentence duration minus available buffered duration before the sink returns; this is not all unexplained SQL/CPU time
important_timing_caveat.better_comparison: Jobs first_audio_queued_ms, adjusted for its earlier ASR/job time base, actual first-sentence PCM duration, and measured queue wait wall time

optimization_only_if_ARM_measurement_jus: Keep every packet and post-backpressure authority check; do not move to sentence-only checks or a time-based grace period

Collapse per-ID dependency queries into one indexed joined/NOT EXISTS read covering exact turn generation/status, user and assistant state/scope, required admitted-user dependency, and all recorded sources

If connection open cost dominates, use a request/worker-owned read connection with a fresh autocommit statement or read transaction per check, explicitly closed by its owner; never retain one read snapshot across packets
Continue checking the original live ProfileAccess grant per packet, fail closed on SQLite errors, and preserve full final binding and actual player ACK
Avoid a RAM-only validity cache unless every external writer and permission invalidation is proven observable; the existing independent-Store invalidation regressions must still pass
limitations: Local Windows smoke timings cannot establish ARM cost or explain the observed underrun count
The five-second first-sentence sink span can include normal queue backpressure; root is measuring before any optimization decision
No code or check-frequency change is proposed as already deployed
